trivia.ruleCorrect: A correct answer moves you forward.
trivia.ruleWrong: A wrong answer can send you back.

riskuj.title: BBFRAXY | Riskuj
riskuj.heading: Riskuj
riskuj.description: A trivia game for a group of friends, a family evening or an entire Discord. Pick topics, collect points and find out who has the most useless knowledge in their head.
riskuj.howToPlayDescription: The game board has several topics, each with questions worth different point values. A player or team chooses a square, the moderator reads the question and the player answers.
riskuj.ruleCorrect: A correct answer adds the question's value.
riskuj.ruleWrong: A wrong answer can subtract points, like in classic Riskuj.
riskuj.ruleNext: After evaluation, the next player or team continues.
riskuj.ruleWinner: The highest score wins after the board is cleared.
riskuj.idealDiscordDescription: One person can be the moderator and share their screen with everyone else. The game runs locally in the browser, with no registration or server.
riskuj.customRules: Adjust the rules to your group — for example who can answer after a mistake, whether to use a time limit or how to handle a tie.
riskuj.prepareHeading: How do you want to prepare the game?
riskuj.preparedQuizDescription: Upload your {file} and set players, colors and the timer.
riskuj.prepareBeforeStartDescription: Choose the number of topics and questions in each topic and create the game right now.

competition.title: BBFRAXY | FraXy's Competition
competition.heading: FraXy's Competition
competition.description: A guessing competition across a map of Europe. Click a country, estimate the correct number and get the highest score possible.
competition.howItWorksDescription: You'll get “guess the number” questions on a map of Europe. The closer you are to the real value, the higher your score.
competition.onePassDescription: Each country can be answered once. After all questions are answered, the final score is shown.
competition.rulesDescription: You'll get a series of “guess the number” questions for each European country. Your goal is to get as close to reality as possible.
competition.rule1: Pick a country on the map.
competition.rule3: You can earn up to 100 points per country based on accuracy.
competition.rule4: After answering all countries, you'll see your total result.
competition.guessDescription: Click a point on the map and try to estimate the answer as accurately as possible.
competition.questionOverviewDescription: Your answer, the correct answer, the difference and the points earned.
